domains.name: Finance
domains.purpose: Track recognised service revenue and profitability against the monthly performance threshold.

metrics.name: Recognised revenue
metrics.definition: Revenue recognised when a service obligation is fulfilled, excluding VAT and net of credits.

metrics.name: Gross margin
metrics.definition: Recognised revenue remaining after direct delivery costs, as a percentage of recognised revenue.
metrics.formula: Σ gross profit ÷ Σ recognised revenue × 100
metrics.exclusions: Corporate overhead and months without a revenue denominator.

domains.name: Commercial
domains.purpose: Understand booked work and how often closed opportunities turn into wins.

metrics.name: Net bookings
metrics.definition: Signed service order value net of cancellations in the month, independent of revenue recognition.
metrics.formula: Σ signed order value net of cancellations

metrics.name: Win rate
metrics.definition: Share of closed sales opportunities classified as won in the close month.
metrics.formula: Σ won opportunities ÷ Σ closed opportunities × 100

domains.name: Operations
domains.purpose: Compare reliable service delivery across the regional network.

metrics.name: On-time delivery
metrics.definition: Share of completed visits that met the original committed completion time.
metrics.formula: Σ on-time completions ÷ Σ completed visits × 100
metrics.exclusions: Open and cancelled visits. A reschedule does not reset the original deadline.

metrics.name: Completed visits
metrics.definition: Completed service visits counted once during their completion month.
metrics.formula: Σ distinct completed visits at source
metrics.exclusions: Cancelled visits and open work orders.

domains.name: People Analytics
domains.purpose: Monitor training coverage and absence pressure using regional cohort aggregates.

metrics.name: Training compliance
metrics.definition: Share of eligible employee-month observations with all mandatory training current at month end.
metrics.formula: Σ compliant employee-months ÷ Σ eligible employee-months × 100
metrics.exclusions: Workers outside the training policy. The ratio across months weights eligible employee-months.

metrics.name: Absence rate
metrics.definition: Share of scheduled workdays lost to unplanned absence in the selected period.
metrics.formula: Σ unplanned absence days ÷ Σ scheduled workdays × 100
metrics.exclusions: Planned holiday and approved training time.
